rows.quote: To investigate potential mediating pathways through which BPS-targeted proteins might contribute to depression, multi-omics data were integrated, including proteome-wide association study datasets from the FINNGEN biobank, the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, and the Icelandic deCODE consortium, as well as human plasma metabolomic datasets.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rule C2): the sentence names the FINNGEN biobank as a proteome dataset; the pqtl side of the dictionary has no FinnGen row under any release (its FinnGen rows are all on the outcome side). No accession.
Step 4 of the decision order (rule D): the abstract gives the name deCODE alone, with no citation, N, platform or year; the pqtl side has two deCODE rows and nothing separates them. No accession.
Step 4 of the decision order (rule D): the abstract gives the name UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project alone, with no subcohort, N, ancestry or citation; four UKB-PPP rows remain. No accession.
